This build stores everything only on this device. No accounts, servers, or backend are required.

Test limitations
  • Multiple phones will not sync with each other.
  • One device should be the official Host device.
  • Use the Display tab on the same device/tablet or mirror the screen to a TV.
  • Smart partnerships use skill balance plus repeat-partner avoidance.
